JNCCMNCR10437611,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023889,1996-07-26,1996-07-26,D,Lea Taing (Deer Sound),Point,58.9795838875419,-2.79113249690005,WGS84,123276,Henricia,FALSE,O,,FALSE,Large angular boulders with Saccorhiza polyschides, Bonnemaisonia asparagoides and Laminaria hyperborea. Vertical and steep rock with Alcyonium digitatum, Balanus crenatus, bryozoan crusts and red algal crust. Dense patches of Alcyonidium diaphinum on verticals. Upper rock surfaces supported kelp grazed by Echinus esculentus. Trailliella sp. with amphipod tubes frequent.

JNCCMNCR10437688,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023891,1996-07-26,1996-07-26,D,Lea Taing (Deer Sound),Point,58.9795838875419,-2.79113249690005,WGS84,103471,Aplidium,FALSE,O,,FALSE,Vertical bedrock, dominated by dense clusters of Clavelina lepadiformis and Antedon bifida subject to tidal currents (<1 kn). Occasional Laminaria hyperborea and Plocamium cartilagineum. Patches of bryozoan crust, encrusting corallinaceae and a Cellaria sp. turf. Pomatoceros triqueter on rock, and Cereus pedunculatus around crevices. Only occasional small Alcyonium digitatum.

JNCCMNCR10437799,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023893,1996-07-27,1996-07-27,D,E of Rerwick Head (Deer Sound),Point,58.9840772916962,-2.78496337533003,WGS84,123276,Henricia,FALSE,O,,FALSE,Tide-swept stepped bedrock, generally low-lying with abundant Rhodophyta indet. crusts surrounded by pebbles and shell gravel. Vertical faces dominated by Alcyonium digitatum with Pomatoceros triqueter, Balanus crenatus and bryozoan crusts. Horizontals largely devoid of any fauna with Echinus esculentus and scattered Urticina felina. Crevices supported brittle stars and feather stars.

JNCCMNCR10437987,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023900,1996-07-28,1996-07-28,D,The Gloup (Deer Sound),Point,58.9552486979208,-2.71080473217342,WGS84,143691,Corallinaceae,FALSE,O,,FALSE,Bedrock vertical faces at either side of enclosed section dominated by a mixed turf of Dendrodoa grossularia, Diplosoma spongiforme, Leucosolenia complicata, Grantia compressa and Scypha ciliata. Underhangs were dominated by extensive patches of Halichondria panicea. Lower sections became silt covered showing reduced fauna.

JNCCMNCR10438046,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023903,1996-07-28,1996-07-28,D,Cave S of the Gloup (Deer Sound),Point,58.9557486561538,-2.70997153865465,WGS84,103439,Didemnidae,FALSE,O,,FALSE,An area at the entrance of a surge gully dominated by a variety of red algae including Cryptopleura ramosa, Plocamium cartilagineum, Odonthalia dentata and Phycodrys rubens. Occaisional Dictyota dichotoma was also present. A number of ascidians were amongst the algae along with the bryozoan crisiids and Henricia sp. Covering much of the algae were spirorbids.

JNCCMNCR10438078,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023904,1996-07-28,1996-07-28,D,Cave S of the Gloup (Deer Sound),Point,58.9557486561538,-2.70997153865465,WGS84,103882,Dendrodoa grossularia,FALSE,S,,FALSE,A vertical surge gully wall, 20 m from the entrance, was covered with superabundant Dendrodoa grossularia interspersed with Leucosolenia complicata and Clathrina coriacea. Encrusting the walls were encrusting sponges, bryozoan crusts and spirorbids. In the crevices and fissures were Ophiopholis aculeata, Cancer pagurus and Galathea squamifera.

JNCCMNCR10438115,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023908,1996-07-28,1996-07-28,D,Peter's Pool (Deer Sound),Point,58.9234972806994,-2.79853242027129,WGS84,107398,Necora puber,FALSE,R,,FALSE,Dense bed of Zostera marina on anoxic mud with a thick algal mat around the base of the Zostera marina. Many ascidians were attached to the Zostera sp. leaf litter including Ascidiella aspersa, Ascidia mentula and very large orange Ciona intestinalis (up to 20 cm in length). Esperiopsis fucorum was scattered amongst the base of the Zostera, whilst the blades supported gastropods including Gibbula cineraria. Chorda filum was attached to the leaf litter.

JNCCMNCR10438167,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023910,1996-07-29,1996-07-29,D,Cave S of Mull Head (Deer Sound),Point,58.9712469354294,-2.70813926260676,WGS84,111597,Alcyonidium diaphanum,FALSE,C,,FALSE,Vertical and overhanging surfaces in a cave with dense Dendrodoa grossularia covered by a network of Clathrina coriacea. There were colonial ascidians and sponges throughout the habitats and colonies of Alcyonidium diaphanum.

JNCCMNCR10438208,JNCCMNCR10000446,1996 MNCR Deer Sound (Orkney) sublittoral survey,JNCCMNCR10023914,1996-07-29,1996-07-29,D,Cave S of Chip of the Mull (Deer Sound),Point,58.9712635965464,-2.70815774701404,WGS84,117994,Tubularia indivisa,FALSE,O,,FALSE,A narrow passage, towards the end of the cave with encrusting sponges and Dendrodoa grossularia forming the main rock cover. Pomatoceros triqueter and spirorbids encrusting the rock, with Ophiopholis aculeata in crevices. A sparse scattering of hydroids included Tubularia indivisa and Kirkenpaureia pinnata. Generally, all very low-lying encrusting sponges.
